list.title: Users
list.description: Invite, edit, and manage access for everyone in your school.
list.caption: School users

deactivate.title: Deactivate user
deactivate.body: This immediately suspends the account and signs it out everywhere. It cannot be undone from this screen.
deactivate.noSessions: This user has no active sessions or registered devices.
deactivate.consequence: This will end $t(adminPeople.users.deactivate.sessionCount, {"count": {{sessionCount}} }) across $t(adminPeople.users.deactivate.deviceCount, {"count": {{deviceCount}} }), and cancel any pending invitations for this account.
deactivate.successDescription: {{revoked}} session(s) revoked across their devices; {{invitations}} pending invitation(s) cancelled.

staff.title: Principal & finance accounts
staff.description: Give your principal and finance staff their own Studafy accounts.

invite.title: Invite a principal or finance staff member
invite.signInNote: We email them an invitation link. They open it and sign in with their Google or Microsoft (Outlook) account using this exact email address — there is no password to set.

list.caption: Principal and finance invitations
list.resentToast: A new invitation was sent to {{email}}.
list.empty: No principal or finance invitations yet.

list.title: Students
list.description: Search the student directory, review profiles, and manage guardian links.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or admission number
list.caption: Students

create.title: New student
create.description: Create a student profile and linked account.
create.preferredNameHelper: Optional — shown instead of the legal name where it fits.
create.admissionNumberHelper: Must be unique within this school.

linkGuardian.title: Add guardian
linkGuardian.description: Link an existing parent account to this student.

unlinkGuardian.title: Remove guardian
unlinkGuardian.body: This removes the parent-child link. The guardian will no longer see this student's records.

hints.admission_number: Your school's unique ID for the student.
hints.email: Optional. Students without an email sign in with their Studafy ID. An import never changes an existing student's sign-in email.
hints.status: One of {{values}}. Blank means applicant for a new student.
hints.parent_email: Optional. Parents without an email sign in with their Studafy ID. An email that already has an account is not linked.
hints.parent_name: The parent's full name. Give a name or an email, plus the relationship.
hints.parent_relationship: One of {{values}} (Arabic words such as أم or أب work too).
hints.grade: The grade to place the student in, spelled as in Academics, for example Grade 1.
hints.section: The section of that grade, for example A. Leave blank if the grade has only one section.
hints.family: Any number or code you choose. Brothers and sisters with the same family number share their parents, so you only type the parents once.

import.parentPairWarning: Map {{relationship}} together with {{name}} or {{email}}. Rows that give a parent without a relationship are rejected.

blocker.missing: Map a column to every required field before confirming. Missing: {{fields}}.
blocker.unapplied: You changed the mapping. Apply it to re-check the file before confirming.
blocker.noValidRows: No rows passed validation, so there is nothing to import.

mapping.heading: Match your columns
mapping.intro_one: {{count}} column found on line {{line}} of {{file}}. Check each match, choose a column for anything that is missing, then apply the mapping to re-check the file.
mapping.intro_other: {{count}} columns found on line {{line}} of {{file}}. Check each match, choose a column for anything that is missing, then apply the mapping to re-check the file.
mapping.saveAsHelper: Name this mapping to reuse it next time.
mapping.recordsIntro: Columns for the fields on your school's published student record form. Leave a field unmapped to skip it; a blank cell never clears an answer already on file.
mapping.recordSensitive: Sensitive: encrypted, and shown masked in the preview.
mapping.recordDocument: {{field}} is a document field and cannot be imported. Upload its files on the student's Records tab.

diff.heading: Preview changes
diff.intro: What confirming would do to your student records right now. Nothing has been saved yet.
diff.loadError: Couldn't load the preview. You can still confirm; the import is checked again when it runs.
diff.caption: Changes per row
diff.newParentAccount: Creates a new parent account and household

conflicts.DUPLICATE_ADMISSION_NUMBER_IN_FILE: An earlier line has the same admission number. The first line is imported.
conflicts.DUPLICATE_EMAIL_IN_FILE: An earlier line gives this email to a different admission number.
conflicts.EMAIL_MISMATCH: This student already exists and signs in with a different email.
conflicts.EMAIL_BELONGS_TO_OTHER_STUDENT: This email already belongs to another student.
conflicts.EMAIL_BELONGS_TO_STAFF: This email belongs to a staff account.
conflicts.PARENT_EMAIL_BELONGS_TO_STUDENT: The parent email is the email of a new student in this file.

diff.siblingParent: Joins the new parent created on line {{line}} (siblings share one parent)
diff.parentAccountExists: This parent email already belongs to an account, so no link is made. The student is still imported: link the parent from the student's Guardians tab or Finance > Unlinked.
diff.parentConflictsBanner_one: {{count}} row names a parent email that already belongs to an account. Those students are imported without a parent link; link the parent yourself from the student's Guardians tab or Finance > Unlinked. An import never matches people by email.
diff.parentConflictsBanner_other: {{count}} rows name a parent email that already belongs to an account. Those students are imported without a parent link; link the parent yourself from the student's Guardians tab or Finance > Unlinked. An import never matches people by email.
diff.newSecondParentAccount: Creates a second parent account in the same household
diff.parentsKept: Already has a parent in Studafy, so the import adds none
diff.parentEmailInOtherFamily: Another family in this file already uses this parent email, so this parent is not linked. The student is still imported: link the parent from the student's Guardians tab.

placementConflicts.NO_ACADEMIC_YEAR: Not placed in a class: there is no current or upcoming academic year yet. Add one in Academics, then import again.
placementConflicts.GRADE_NOT_FOUND: Not placed in a class: no grade called “{{grade}}” has sections this year.
placementConflicts.SECTION_NOT_FOUND: Not placed in a class: {{grade}} has no section “{{section}}” this year.
placementConflicts.SECTION_REQUIRED: Not placed in a class: {{grade}} has several sections, so give the section.

diff.placementConflictsBanner_one: {{count}} student will be imported without a class, because their grade or section was not found. Check the spelling against Academics, or place them by hand afterwards.
diff.placementConflictsBanner_other: {{count}} students will be imported without a class, because their grade or section was not found. Check the spelling against Academics, or place them by hand afterwards.

members.title: School members
members.description: Your students, teachers, parents and attendance officers. Everyone gets a Studafy ID automatically, and that ID is their username.
members.signInNote: They sign in on the mobile app with their ID as the username. The first time, they use a one-time setup code from you to choose their own password. Codes last 14 days and are shown only once, when you issue them — when you add someone, reset their password, or issue codes for everyone who hasn't signed in yet.
members.setupCodeNote: Give them these details now: the code can't be shown again. They use it once, at their first sign-in, to choose their own password.
members.setupCodeMissing: The account was created, but no setup code was issued. Use Reset password to issue one.

add.title: Add a member
add.description: No email needed: they sign in with their ID and a password.

reset.title: Reset password?
reset.explain: Their current password and any earlier setup code stop working, and they're signed out on every device. You'll get a new one-time setup code to give them; they'll choose a new password with it.
reset.done: Password reset. Give them this new setup code.

issue.STUDENT: Issue codes to students not signed up
issue.INSTRUCTOR: Issue codes to teachers not signed up
issue.PARENT: Issue codes to parents not signed up
issue.ATTENDANCE_OFFICER: Issue codes to attendance officers not signed up

codes.none: Everyone here already has a password or an unexpired setup code.
codes.done_one: Issued {{count}} setup code. The list has been downloaded.
codes.done_other: Issued {{count}} setup codes. The list has been downloaded.
codes.keepSafe: Anyone with this file can claim those accounts. Hand the codes out, then delete it.

guardians.hint: Pick the parent accounts to link. Without a guardian the student belongs to no family: no sibling discount, and no parent can see or pay their fees.

children.hint: Pick the students this parent is a guardian of. A parent with no children sees no fees and gets no fee notices.

teachers.caption: Every teacher, by name
teachers.terminationHelper: Set when the teacher leaves. Needs a hire date.
teachers.datesInvalid: The end date needs a hire date, on or before it.
teachers.numberTaken: Another teacher already has this employee number.
